Hyperledger Quilt (interledger4j) v1.0.0 Release

Implementations and SDKs
java
Oct 11, 2019
S
David Fuelling
Oct 11, 2019 #1

I am pleased to announce v1.0.0 of Hyperledger Quilt, which is a Java implementation of core Interledger libraries.

This release provides Java implementations of core Interledger primitives including ILPv4 packets, ASN.1 OER codecs, and sub-protocol support for BTP, IL-DCP, SPSP, ILP-over-HTTP, and STREAM.

  • Github Project Info : https://github.com/hyperledger/quilt
  • Artifacts in Maven Central : https://search.maven.org/search?q=g:org.interledger
  • Github Release (release notes, Javadoc, artifacts): https://github.com/hyperledger/quilt/releases/tag/v1.0.0
  • Issues Fixed in v1.0.0 : https://github.com/hyperledger/quilt/milestone/2?closed=1

Please reach out or visit the project’s README for more information, or to get involved with the Quilt project.
